scientific_assessment: Two fresh matched-seed1 recipes and one fixed1000game500pair arena on reserved history-bearing openings can test whether the selected development contrast survives both a new training seed and new openings. It does not isolate which change causes differences.

Selecting the best challenger by aligned development score against the same C checkpoint is a reasonable deterministic allocation heuristic. It supplies no direct E-versus-G significance or strength ordering beyond those conditional screens.
One100-simulation horizon is a useful bounded follow-up. Current root and wise-cloud configs have base100,fast32,start256; this is not full deployed-budget or search-scaling confirmation.
Hard4.5+4.5+1.5GPUhours is internally consistent; separate CPU caps, shared lease and no automatic retries preserve budget scope.
Single fresh paired seed cannot estimate seed variance, and terminal-opening disjointness is not training purity or separation of opening families/later transpositions.

proposed_clarifications.change: Make the otherwise branch apply only to a complete independently qualified E0T05 bank. Missing/invalid/incomplete evidence must stop conditional selection, not count as an unfavored challenger.

Fix candidate/reference names for every selected pair and record the expected development direction. Keeping C as reference and E0T05/G20T05 as candidate is simplest: support for C is a negative candidate interval.

Distinguish decisive opposite-direction fresh evidence from a fresh interval containing zero; report the former as contradictory only when the prior development contrast was itself decisive. A prior inconclusive contrast is unresolved development evidence, even if the new bank becomes decisive.

Once all selection banks are complete, check their terminal EPDs against the frozen exclusion set and reserved bank before calling the confirmation openings fresh. Preserve history-bearing bank SHA and FEN-list loader/readout validation.

not_recommended: No extra E-versus-G match solely to validate the selection heuristic.
No automatic400-simulation or fast/start-budget arenas, further training seeds or horizon extension from this draft.
limits: No E0T05 run/status/output or partial outcome inspection.
Read draft, existing generation metadata/README and current relevant config values only; no new corpus/target/payload scan or arena.
This supports preparation with clarifications, not final preregistration, launch approval or a chosen pair. Operational launcher delta remains a separate later review.
